title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot (Writing Assistance) gains enterprise data protection
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, default, licensing and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should complete the Group Policy path and acknowledge Microsoft's differing user-toggle labels and earlier Beta rollout documentation.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to upgrade Writing Assistance in Edge to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers.
claims.quote: is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers.
claims.fix: Append to the rollout paragraph: "The archived Edge Beta release notes for version 141.0.3537.25 (September 17, 2025) also describe this upgrade as a controlled feature rollout; the current roadmap remains In development and MC1146821 expects Worldwide GA in late January 2027." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-relnote-archive-beta-channel#version-1410353725-september-17,-2025.

claims.claim: A separate meter for this Writing Assistance upgrade is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Chat Edge Rewrite Writing Assistance billing usage limits metered pricing; read ComposeInlineEnabled, Microsoft Copilot requirements and copilot/plan/pay-as-you-go-meters. Published meters concern agents, not this writing feature.

claims.claim: The ComposeInlineEnabled reference lists no price.
claims.quote: Searched: Writing Assistance Rewrite ComposeInlineEnabled enterprise data protection price meter limits; opened the complete ComposeInlineEnabled reference. It states prerequisites and policy behavior but no price.

claims.claim: No cap specific to this writing feature is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Chat Edge Rewrite Writing Assistance billing usage limits metered pricing; read ComposeInlineEnabled and support.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-copilot/limits-for-features-copilot-chat. The latter names fair use for some features, not a cap for Edge Writing Assistance.
